contexts.text: Forty days and nights () = the duration of temptation... The reason forty = the duration of temptation comes from this, that the Lord suffered Himself to be tempted for forty days... and as each and all things in... the representative Churches... were types of Him, so too were forty days and nights in representing and signifying all temptation in general; specifically, the duration of the temptation, whatever that duration might be. And as, while a man is in temptation, he is in vastation of all things belonging to proprium and which are corporeal... therefore forty days and nights = also the duration of vastation... AC 760. AC 862. AC 1847. AC 1856.
That forty = the duration of both temptation and vastation. Illustrated.

(In ) it is said forty-two, which is the same as forty. The origin of this is that seven days = the end of vastation and a new beginning; and six = labour, from the six days of labour or of combat. Therefore, from the multiplication of seven by six there results the number forty-two, signifying the duration of the vastation and the duration of the temptation or labour and combat of the man to be regenerated, wherein there is what is holy. But the round number forty was taken instead of the not round number forty-two, as is evident from these passages in the Revelation.

The Israelitish people being led about in the wilderness for forty years... represented... the duration of temptation, and also the duration of vastation; the duration of temptation by this, that they were afterwards introduced into the Holy Land; and the duration of vastation by this, that all who were above twenty years old when they went forth from Egypt died in the wilderness, except Joshua and Caleb...
Forty days () = the duration of the Church called Noah... Here, it says forty days;in , forty days and nights, because it there = the duration of temptation, in which nights are anxieties. AC 862.
It came to pass at the end of forty days () = the duration of the former state, and the beginning of the following one.
Eighty... involves the same as forty, that is, temptations.
Peradventure there shall forty be found there () = those who have been in temptations. (For) forty = temptations. AC 2273.
(Thus) by forty are here signified those with whom goods have been conjoined with truths by means of temptations.
By their journey in gs and wanderings in the wilderness forty years, is described every state of the Church militant, how of itself it yields, but conquers from the Lord.
With those who believe all good and truth to be from the Lord, the price of redemption is signified by forty, and in a higher degree by four hundred.
Isaac was a son of forty years () = from Own power through the combats of temptations... Forty = temptations.
Esau was a son of forty years () = a state of temptation as to the natural good of truth... Forty years = a state of temptation. That forty = temptations. References.
Forty days were fulfilled for him () = a state of preparation by means of temptations. Forty = temptations.
The number forty = the duration of temptation, whatever it may be.
1.2. The life of forty years in the wilderness = temptations. AC 8098:2.

As the conjunction can be effected only by means of temptations, these are signified, that is, when the number forty is added, whether it be forty years, forty months, or forty days; for forty = temptations, and their duration, whatever it may be.
The sons of Israel did eat manna forty years () = the appropriation of the good of truth in a state of all temptations... Forty years = a state of temptations.

Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights () = what is plenary as to information and influx... The reason forty = what is plenary, is that four = what is full, and in like manner ten, and the number forty results from four multiplied into ten.

As forty = what is plenary, Moses remained on Mount Sinai, not only on this occasion but also on another, forty days and forty nights (; ). On this account the sons of Israel wandered in the wilderness forty years, and as it is said, until all that generation was consumed (). Further illustrated. And therefore it rained upon the earth... forty days and forty nights. Hence it is evident why it was ordained that a wicked man was to be smitten with forty stripes (); for forty stripes = punishment to the full. Further illustrated. Thus by forty is signified what is plenary as to representation.
Forty bases of silver () = plenary support by means of truth. Forty = what is plenary.
Forty-two months () has a like signification to six weeks... for six multiplied into seven makes forty-two.
The reason why the temptation after forty days in the wilderness is alone mentioned, is that forty days = ... temptations to the full, thus those of many years.

He was with Jehovah forty days and forty nights () = the temptations before there exists the internal of the Church, of worship, and of the Word. Forty days and nights, when predicated of the Church with man, = a state of temptation. References. AC 10686:end.
That forty years, months, or days = a plenary state of temptations from beginning to end; and that this state is signified by the duration of the Flood for forty days, etc. References.
Forty-two months () = to the very end when there is nothing remaining.

That by forty- two months is signified to the very end when there is not any truth and good of the Church remaining, is because by forty-two the like is signified as by six weeks, for six times seven is forty-two; and by six weeks is signified what is complete to the very end; for the number six has this signification, and weeks = state; and seven weeks = a holy state, which is a new state of the Church, when the Lord begins His Kingdom. The like is signified by this number in (). AE 633.
Moreover the like is signified by this number as by three and a half, because forty-two months make three years and a half.

Forty-two months () = to the end of the former Church while there is a beginning of the New; in like manner as by three and a half; and by a time, and times, and half a time; and also by one thousand two hundred and sixty; because forty-two months make three years and a half.
Forty-two months () = to the very end of the Old Church, and to the beginning of the New.
By the numbers forty and forty-two, in the Word, is signified either the plenary vastation of the Church, or plenary temptation. Illustrated. AE 654:23.

The rain of forty days (at the Flood) = the destruction of (the Most Ancient Church) through falsities of evil; but the beginning of a new Church is signified by the drying up of the earth after those forty days...
For by forty is signified the end of evil, and also the beginning of good...

The vastation of the Church, and also plenary temptation, is signified also by the abiding of the sons of Israel forty years in the wilderness. Illustrated... From these passages it is evident that by forty years is signified not only the vastation of the Church with the sons of Israel, but also plenary temptation; and also by the end of those years the beginning of a New Church. (Explained.)

(Thus) it may appear that by the number forty, in the Word, is signified plenary vastation and consummation, that is, when all the good of the Church is vastated and the evil consummated; and also that by the same number is signified plenary temptation; as also the establishment of the Church anew, that is, reformation, from which it may be known what is signified by the forty-two months during which the nations will trample on the Holy City; and what in like manner by... To the beast... Power was given forty-two months.
By the Lord being in the wilderness forty days He represented the duration of all the temptations which He underwent... for by forty days is signified an entire period and duration of temptations...
Forty years = an entire period of the vastation of the Church, and also the entire duration of temptations.
As the wilderness = a state of temptations, and forty, whether years or days, the entire duration from beginning to end...
Forty-two () = blasphemation.

There was given to him Power to do his works forty-two months () = destruction until nothing of truth and good remained... Forty-two months = plenary vastation and consummation, thus destruction until nothing of truth and good remains. The like is signified by forty-two (), where it is said that forty-two children were torn in pieces...
